text_block_list.text:
To get used to longer distances as soon as 
possible for the Japanese Derby, Winning 
Ticket set her sights on the Hopeful 
Stakes.

However, despite putting in heavy mileage 
for the race, her times just wouldn't 
improve.

Unable to just stand by and watch Winning 
Ticket struggle, Biwa Hayahide proposed a 
mock race between the three of them, 
including Narita Taishin.

Running alongside them, Winning Ticket 
recovered her form as if her previous 
slump had all been a lie, smashing her 
personal best record.

The Trainer realizes just how immensely 
important a "rival" is to Winning Ticket.
